visualizerParams.title: Code Refactor: Recursion Instead of Nested Loops
visualizerParams.problemDescription: Three nested loops generate the permutations of exactly three letters. Write a recursive version with a used[] array that works for any length. The output must stay the same, in the same order.

solution.explanation: Nested loops hard-wire the length: four letters would need a fourth loop. The recursive version adds one letter per level and un-marks it on the way back, so one function handles any length.
